description: Practices: conduct or change explained by shared, routine ways of doing and the things, skills and meanings they combine.
group_name: How a text explains conduct or change
keywords: routine; habit; everyday practice; the way it is done; infrastructure; skills; norms; doing
include: The text explains what people do through the practices they take part in.
source: Spaargaren et al. 2016: 4-8; Shove et al. 2012: 22

description: Individual choice: conduct or change explained by individuals' attitudes, values, preferences, information or rational decisions, or by background variables such as income and education.
group_name: How a text explains conduct or change
keywords: attitude; awareness; behaviour; choice; decide; motivation; preference; inform; nudge; incentive; consumer
include: The text treats conduct as the outcome of individual decisions, or aims to change it by changing minds.

description: Structure or system: conduct or change explained by structures, functions, the needs of a system, constraints acting like forces, or levels (micro and macro; niche, regime and landscape).
group_name: How a text explains conduct or change
keywords: structure; system; regime; landscape; macro; level; forces; functional; constraints; the market
include: The text explains conduct by something above or outside the activity it explains.

description: Technology: change attributed to a technology, or to its spread, by itself.
group_name: How a text explains conduct or change
keywords: technology; innovation; roll-out; uptake; adoption; smart; digital; device; will reduce; will enable
include: The text expects a technology to change conduct without saying how it enters what people do.
source: Shove et al. 2012: 29-30; Spaargaren et al. 2016: 20; Nicolini 2012: 51
